svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
a 2x2 Hill matrix and a key of 4, either order: message = matrix x carved block + a shift that depends on the block's place in the key
blocks of 2 from place 1; boxed in ochre: blocks starting at 1, 5, 9 ... (class 0), the rest class 2. Ochre letters: the 11 first letters, equations for row 1
block 23-24, LR = [11, 17], class 2: row 1 x (11, 17) + shift of class 2 = A = 0
every size and key length, all alignments and four numberings: dead where the equations contradict, open where too few to decide
K4: 536 settings dead, 400 open, 0 alive; ten scrambled coppers: 0 alive; a planted Hill-and-key text comes out alive (recovered)
OUT: NO READING; NO HILL MATRIX WITH A SHORT KEY FITS
